byPath.*: Prices consumer loans and mortgages by credit score and term, and plans their monthly repayment: the payment, the amortization schedule, the total cost and the yearly split of interest and principal
byPath.Installment: One monthly installment of the repayment schedule
byPath.LoanRequest: A loan application: the amount, the term in years and the credit score of the borrower
byPath.annualRate: The base rate of 3.5% plus the premium of the price tier
byPath.compareTerms: The remaining balance of two schedules at the end of each year
byPath.loanCost: The total interest and the total amount paid over the schedule
byPath.loanRepayment: Prices a loan request and returns its monthly repayment schedule
byPath.monthlyPayment: The fixed monthly annuity payment, rounded to cents
byPath.mortgageBook: A 250 000 mortgage over 25 years for a prime borrower: the monthly payment, the total cost, the remaining balance and the yearly split of interest and principal
byPath.mortgageBook.repayment: The repayment plan of the mortgage
byPath.mortgageBook.yearly: The interest and the principal paid in each year of the mortgage
byPath.pricingTier: Selects the price tier and the rate premium from the credit score and the term
byPath.repaymentSchedule: The monthly amortization schedule of the loan
byPath.samplePayment: The monthly payment of the example loan request
byPath.termComparisonBook: The same 180 000 loan over 15 and over 30 years: how much the monthly payment drops, and how much longer the balance stays high
byPath.termComparisonBook.comparison: The remaining balance of both plans at the end of each year
byPath.yearlySummary: The interest and the principal paid in each year, and the balance at the end of the year
